rationale: Vehicle braking behavior is itself what must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking under SG-3 and the H-3 hazardous event of suddenly stopping without an obstacle ahead. P’s declared operational scope matches the hazard. It does not expand the phenomenon to include sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” identifies the system behavior directly addressed by the evaluation target.
Straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather reproduces the supplied hazard’s operational conditions.
“No visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle” is explicitly supported by the hazard’s operational situation, rather than introducing obstacle-detection mechanisms.
